purpose: Teach: 感傷/従順/習性/一服/四角い/極まりない/輝か/育む

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが古い写真で感傷に浸ってらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad got a little lost in some old photographs.
lines.style: Soft, observational tone. A gentle smile in the voice. Noticing something tender without intruding on it. Warm and patient.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに従順にお手伝いしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I helped Dad with things he was doing. Really helped him.
lines.style: Quiet pride, wanting to be heard. Small voice but steady. Emphasize on 'really'—seeking reassurance that it mattered. Open, unguarded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは早起きの習性がおありなのよ
lines.en: Your dad's always been an early riser, you know.
lines.style: Conversational, like sharing something she's noticed over time. Warm knowing. Not lecturing—just noticing aloud with Sho.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと一服のお茶飲んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I sat with Dad and had tea with him. Just the two of us.
lines.style: Bright with the simple joy of closeness. Words tumble slightly—he wants her to understand how special it was. Eager but genuine, not performed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが四角い箱でおもちゃを作って下さったわ
lines.en: Your dad made a toy from a cardboard box. Made it just for you.
lines.style: Tender and pleased. Slight pause before 'just for you'—letting that land. Noticing the quiet generosity in the moment. Warmth in every word.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんへの愛情が極まりないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I love Dad so much. I don't have words for it.
lines.style: Overwhelmed in the best way. Voice soft but full. Small and sincere—not embarrassed, just big feelings in a small voice. Trembling slightly with emotion.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの瞳が誇らしげに輝かれてたわ
lines.en: Your dad's eyes lit up with such pride when he looked at you.
lines.style: Quiet awe. Speaking slowly, reverently. Each word placed with care—this is something she wants him to know he gave his father. Gentle exhale.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんがぼくを育む役目を果たして下さってるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad takes care of me. He helps me grow. That's what he does.
lines.style: Small voice with sudden clarity. Like he's understood something important and is saying it slowly, carefully. Sincere without heaviness. Trust in his words.
